ValidationRule.description: Restricts Users from manually moving records to Stages without going through the Approval Process and DocuSign.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$User.Email != "brittani@teamvelocitymarketing.com" && $Profile.Name != "System Administrator" && RecordType.Name <> "Foundation Opportunity" && (IsChanged(StageName)&& ( ( Flow_Closed_Opportunity__c=false && ( ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won") || ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Upsold") ) ) || ( Open_DocuSign_Envelopes__c = 0 && ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Contract Sent") ) ) )
&& RecordTypeId <> "012Vb000007jxvxIAA"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot choose this Stage manually. Please use the "Close Opportunity" button in the top right.
